merged: **Mont Ventoux Observatory** operates a 60‑cm reflector (installed 2017) and a 20‑cm outreach refractor. Both yield ≈195 useful nights / yr (168 in 2024). Each night ≈400 GB of raw frames are generated and transferred to Marseille in ~40 min (≈400 GB per night, giving a similar monthly total – exact nightly vs monthly figure is uncertain). A new main camera was installed in March 2025, reducing read‑noise by 30 % but requiring a full‑night offline firmware update. **Past incidents** – 2023 dome‑motor seizure bent the counterweight rod (repaired; limit switch added); February 2025 a 1.2 s timestamp offset (undetected) lost three weeks of photometry (now GPS‑checked each session). **Operational rules** – no observing on outreach evenings; raw frames are compressed after two years and never deleted; any acquisition‑software change must be tested on a dedicated night. **Pending items** – a Spanish collaboration awaits review/evaluation of a shared scheduling tool;
